title: Hiking Gift Set Printable, Hiking Journal + National Parks Tracker + Trip Planner PDF, Last Minute Gift for Hiker, Adventure Log Bundle
description:
Three HikeSupply printables together: a gift set for a hiker who likes to plan trips and remember them. $15.99 instead of $18.97 bought separately, and you can give it the same day.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
- Hiking Journal & Trail Log: a year of hikes on 64 pages, with a 52-hike tracker, a miles / km tracker, a bucket list and 52 hike log pages
- US National Parks Hiking Tracker: all 63 US national parks with a beginner day hike each, a visit log and stamp boxes, plus Canada's parks (26 pages)
- Hiking Trip Planner: one page per hike, a pre-departure check, a hike log and a season overview

WHAT YOU GET
- Every printable in US Letter and A4, in one ZIP per paper size
- Instant download. These are digital files; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Park rules change, so check nps.gov or parks.canada.ca before a trip. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
